versions.content: AdminData field in ECU Configuration Parameter Definition XML file An AdminData field is required at the beginning of every ECU Configuration Parameter Definition XML file (regardless whether it is the StMD or the VSMD file) to allow the setting of AdminData for the whole XML File.
